item.title: Belgian Startup Those Vegan Cowboys Raises €10M for Animal-Free Cheese
item.dc:creator: Redactie
item.description:
Ghent-based Those Vegan Cowboys has closed a €10 million funding round to scale precision fermentation casein production.

The post Belgian Startup appeared first on vegconomist.
